The '''Jhanjaari River''' was located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The [[Water/Legends|river]], which flowed from Chandrila's [[Shashwaat Mountains]] to [[Lake Sah'ot]] and then to the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]], separated the western edge of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] from the [[Hanna Wild Game Reserve]], a hunting reserve located near the capital.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jhanjaari River was pictured in the in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> It was first identified by name in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' expansion ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
